title: Filters
summary: Gentle film treatments shown on the sample clip: a faded warm grade as the base look, soft bloom, light leaks and haze, fine grain, paper edges and slow lens moves. Previews run at full strength; use less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "soft_film", "amount": 0.7}}} and {"name": "sun_leak", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 1.2, "amount": 0.7}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "cream_flash", "amount": 0.7, "where": "in"}}. Theme effects: library/themes/lifestyle/effects/theme_effects.py; engine: library/_shared/effects_engine.py (OpenCV).

items.name: soft film
items.description: The theme base look: faded and warm, teal-green in the lifted shadows, cream in the highlights. Use around 0.7 on footage.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Late-afternoon sun: amber highlights, warm shadows and a soft glow falling from the top.

items.name: mint fade
items.description: A matte pale-mint print: colour held back, blacks lifted high, the paper tint washed through.

items.name: pastel wash
items.description: A soft colour wash over the picture: sage from the top melting into blush at the bottom.

items.name: dream bloom
items.description: Soft diffusion: highlights spill into a wide creamy glow and fine detail softens.

items.name: sun leak
items.description: A warm light leak drifting across the frame from one side to the other.

items.name: lens haze
items.description: Shooting into the light: a milky warm haze from a top corner that lowers contrast as it swells.

items.name: cream flash
items.description: A soft dip to cream for cuts: the picture washes out to paper rather than flashing hard.

items.name: soft grain
items.description: Fine film grain, a little softer than digital noise, with the odd speck of dust.

items.name: paper glow
items.description: A light vignette: the edges fade toward the paper colour instead of going dark.

items.name: paper mat
items.description: A paper border grows in from the edges, like a mounted print. The picture is not scaled.

items.name: tilt blur
items.description: Soft focus falling off toward the top and bottom, leaving a sharp band across the middle.

items.name: slow push
items.description: A gentle push-in that keeps creeping for as long as the effect runs.

items.name: halation
items.description: Shared engine: red-orange glow around the brightest highlights, as on film stock.

items.name: focus
items.description: Shared engine: the picture pulls out of focus and back.

items.name: whip
items.description: Shared engine: a fast sideways blur, for a whip-pan cut.

items.name: bloom
items.description: Shared engine: a plain neutral glow on the highlights.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
